title: MissionForge player communication
description: Quick pings, emoji reactions and role tags (design section 3.4). There is no free-text chat.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to the JSON Schema of this file, for editor support. Loaders ignore it.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

free_text_chat.description: False: players cannot type free text (child safety).

quick_pings.description: Quick pings in design order, shown on the host screen next to the avatar of the sender.

id.description: Unique ping ID, sent as pingId in ping.send.

text_key.description: String key of the ping text.

id.description: Unique reaction ID, sent as pingId in ping.send.

label_key.description: String key of the screen-reader label of the emoji (design section 16).

role_tags.description: Badges a role-holder can put on an option.

name_key.description: String key of the badge text.

own_area_only.description: True if a role-holder can tag only options in the area of the role.

visible_to_all.description: True if every player sees the badge.
